facts.text: Leon 先于叙述者进门，并问叙述者是否还好。
facts.anchor: Leon walked in ahead of me.

facts.text: Bianca 已在 Star 床边：把念珠缠在 Star 手上，再把自己的手包在 Star 的手上。
facts.anchor: She had wrapped a rosary in Star’s hand and wrapped her hand around Star’s.

facts.text: Leon 起身检查邻床男子的 IV，随后把他的尿盆端走倒空。
facts.anchor: Leon got up to check the guy’s IV, then took his bedpan away to empty it.

facts.text: Bianca 转告：她来时见到了 Claude，Claude 问起叙述者；还转述 Claude 想让医院警察来取她们的证词。
facts.anchor: Claude said she was gonna try and get the hospital cops to come and get our testimony.

facts.text: 三人当场替 Star 筹划 bat mitzvah：地点 Pyramid Club，入场曲 Lucky Star，借 Bianca 的金线套装裙，给她做一顶王冠。
facts.anchor: So we planned Star’s bat mitzvah.

facts.text: Claude 查房：先检查 IV、关掉开关让持续作响的蜂鸣器停下；随后告知 Star 自主呼吸不好，开始用 Bactrim。
facts.anchor: She’s not breathing too well on her own, so we’re starting her on Bactrim.

facts.text: 三人陪 Star 到探视时间结束；因难以三人留宿过夜，Bianca 留下守夜；他们吻了她不像有淤青的额头；警察始终没有出现。
facts.anchor: We sat with Star until visiting hours were up.

facts.text: 叙述者回家后取出久未动用的速写本，画 Star 的 shayna punim（她愈合后可能会想成为的样子）；翌日清晨听留言，Claude 在留言里让她要有耐心。
facts.anchor: I took out my sketchbook for the first time in a while and drew Star’s shayna punim, her beautiful face, as she might like it to look one day when she was healed.

relations.relation: 朋友/床边守候：Bianca 把念珠缠在 Star 手上，并把自己的手包在 Star 手上。
relations.anchor: wrapped a rosary in Star’s hand

relations.relation: 陪伴：叙述者坐到 Bianca 身边，Bianca 把另一只手放进她手里。
relations.anchor: She put her other hand in mine.

relations.relation: 施害与受害：男友打了她（Leon 问是不是他干的；他见过她耳边的 KS 斑点）。
医护/病人：Claude 处置她的 IV、说明用药与预后，并说她很强、会打好这一仗。
relations.anchor: She seems strong, she’ll put up a good fight.

relations.relation: 牵挂/暧昧：Claude 留言说一直在想她，希望她照顾好自己。
伴侣：François 神志不清时，Leon 会听他说下去，再面无表情地回一句。
relations.anchor: in his derangement, Leon would listen to whatever he had to say

relations.relation: 旧友/逝者：Mark 第一次住院时被告知是 PCP，七个月后死去。
relations.anchor: The first time Mark went to the hospital

relations.relation: 经 Bianca 转述的问候：Claude 问起叙述者。

numbers.text: Leon 的四个哥哥（他受过他们的欺凌）。
Mark 第一次住院被告知 PCP 的时间：November ’83。
Mark 死去距此的时长：seven months later。
Claude 给出的 PCP 复发率：约一半病人一年内复发。
numbers.anchor: about half my patients have a recurrence within a year

numbers.text: Star 家人可能离开的年份：’59。
难以三人留宿过夜的人数：three people。
黑眼圈占据半张脸：half her face。
Star 耳边 KS 斑点的大小：small as a dime。
梦里与 Claude 走过的街：Eleventh Street。

turning_point.text: 本章转折点：Claude 报出治疗与预后（开始用 Bactrim；若确诊 PCP，约一半病人一年内复发）后，叙述者由「找到她就好了」跌回 Mark 之死的旧创，甚至自问若 Star 治得好而 Mark 没有，自己会不会怨恨 Star。
turning_point.anchor: The first time Mark went to the hospital, they told him it was PCP—that was November ’83. He died seven months later.
